title: PAR-03/7Q SECTIONOBJECT indicator-color DXF group correction
scope: Reconcile the numeric SECTIONOBJECT indicator-color DXF code with Autodesk's class-specific reference
Correct typed SECTIONOBJECT parse and write for the documented numeric group
Retain compatibility with prior libdxfrw output without promoting undocumented color representations

autodeskSectionDxf.finding: The SECTION DXF reference lists indicator color under group codes 63 and 411.

autodeskGroupTypes.finding: Group codes 60-79 have 16-bit integer values and codes 410-419 are strings; therefore the existing numeric indicator-color field maps to code 63, while the code-411 representation requires separate string semantics.

localSource.finding: The typed SECTIONOBJECT parser and writer used code 62 for m_indicatorColor, contrary to the class-specific SECTION table. The typed parser and writer now use code 63; code 62 remains an accepted legacy spelling on input.
localSource.limit: The SectionObject DWG CMC path still discards RGB. Code 411 and truecolor/name mappings are not inferred from this correction.

generatedControls.finding: Generated direct-parser controls accept code 63 and legacy code 62. A focused writer wire control requires code 63.
generatedControls.limit: No external or persistent DXF fixture was added; these controls establish local typed behavior only.

productionSummary: Parse SECTIONOBJECT indicator color from documented DXF group 63.
Continue accepting group 62 as legacy libdxfrw input.
Write the typed numeric indicator-color field using group 63.
generatedTestSummary: Add focused parser controls for canonical group 63 and legacy group 62.
Add a focused writer wire assertion for group 63.

commands.command: git diff --check -- CMakeLists.txt src/drw_entities.cpp src/drw_entities.h src/libdxfrw.cpp tests/hardening_tests.cpp tests/wave1_tests.cpp

assessment.confirmedLocalResult: SECTIONOBJECT's typed scalar indicator color now uses documented numeric DXF group 63 in both read and write paths, while prior local group-62 output remains readable.
unresolved: Group 411 is listed in the class table but is string-valued; its specific Section indicator-color role is not represented by the current model and was not guessed.
The SectionObject DWG CMC parser and writer do not yet retain the RGB payload.
The broader scalar-only CMC consumer audit and HATCH C5 producer behavior remain open.
assessment.nextAction: Continue the PAR-134 class-by-class audit with MLeader and MLeaderStyle CMC fields, preserving only color information supported by each class's model and documented wire contract.
